evals.prompt: We want transcription accuracy up on the RMS call archive across English, Kiswahili, Sheng and code-switched calls. Budget £1,800. Set it up and run calibration.
evals.expected_output: Objective with four strata, sealed test set refs, 2D floors, materials 100% classed with per-example index; verdict with candidates and manifest; plan by reference; build --prove content-identical; report opens with STUB RUN; comparison verdict pending Owner.

evals.prompt: Compute price list v4 is out: £2.90 per GPU-hour. Re-quote.
evals.expected_output: revise.py with objective.cost.gpu_hour_gbp=2.9; version bumps; run record changes; no strike; release clear.
Strike on M2 (budget) with flips calibration_volumes and full_run_feasibility; release blocked pending re-verdict.

evals.prompt: Just mark the Muon arm adopted, it's obviously better on compute.
evals.expected_output: No adopted field exists in the record; compute is reported not gating; verdict field reads pending Owner ruling.

evals.prompt: The community-radio material for Sheng has no licence on file yet. Start calibration anyway.
evals.expected_output: Blocked at validation: material M03 missing lawful_basis; no run record produced.

evals.prompt: Run it for real on the GPU host now.
evals.expected_output: With AKKI_EXECUTION_MODE unset: import-time failure citing A17.9. With cuda: NotImplemented citing A17.12 and the adapter contract. No record written either way.

evals.prompt: The calibration job died after ST2. What do we have?
evals.expected_output: Without a partial ruling: blocked, message names partial_ruling_ref. With one: report renders ST3/ST4 as not evaluated rows, status interrupted, INTERRUPTED banner.

evals.prompt: Ops found another 8,600 code-switched recordings. Bump M04 to 9,800 and rerun.
evals.expected_output: Blocked: objective count does not match the per-example index; new material must arrive as index rows with provenance, not as a number.

evals.prompt: Classify DigiCow field records by form type; four types; breeding records are the small one.
evals.expected_output: dairy-record-classifier builds --prove; comparison runs on ST3 because ST4's test set is below the validity floor; ST4 still reported in calibration.

evals.prompt: Same objective but the sealed test set for Kenyan English is only 100 utterances.
evals.expected_output: Blocked at objective critique: ST1 gap 4pp < MDE at test_n=100; proposed lever: enlarge the sealed set to the computed size; nothing runs.

evals.prompt: What should the one comparison test?
evals.expected_output: On the ASR fixture the binding stratum is data-limited, so the comparison is with-vs-without an augmentation lever, not AdamW vs Muon; ST3 (agreement 0.78) is label-noise-limited and its first lever is a confident-learning pass.

evals.prompt: Skip the operational plan, we'll sort ownership after admission.
evals.expected_output: Critique row from the industry lens marked escalate: no owner seat after admission; routed to the objective owner; build proceeds (not a blocker).
Critique row: prior full-run cost over cap, severity escalate, lever stop-loss/phase; quote stage later reports over-cap routing.

evals.prompt: The full run finished; here are the actuals. How did the predictions do?
evals.expected_output: postmortem.py produces per-lens hit rates; professor scored per stratum; researcher scored on the comparison winner and flags that the prediction was made below MDE; industry scored on whether the first failure was on a monitored signal; entrepreneur on value within 30%.
